name: seven-bits-coffee-desktop
description: Seven Bits Coffee POS, packaged as a desktop app - an Electron wrapper around the existing zero-dependency Node backend, no separate build step for the app itself.
author: Seven Bits Coffee

scripts.dist: npm run rebuild-native && node scripts/set-variant.js regular && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run rebuild-native && node scripts/set-variant.js regular && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run rebuild-native && node scripts/set-variant.js regular && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run rebuild-native && node scripts/set-variant.js regular && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win:demo: npm run rebuild-native && node scripts/set-variant.js demo && electron-builder --win --config.productName="Seven Bits Coffee (Demo)" --config.appId=com.sevenbitscoffee.desktop.demo
scripts.dist:mac:demo: npm run rebuild-native && node scripts/set-variant.js demo && electron-builder --mac --config.productName="Seven Bits Coffee (Demo)" --config.appId=com.sevenbitscoffee.desktop.demo
scripts.dist:linux:demo: npm run rebuild-native && node scripts/set-variant.js demo && electron-builder --linux --config.productName="Seven Bits Coffee (Demo)" --config.appId=com.sevenbitscoffee.desktop.demo
